reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: Absolutely horrible app. Terrible recipes and useless information. EXTREMELY expensive for the garbage you get for it. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY!!!

reviews.title: Don’t do it! Billed for over a year after trial.
reviews.text: Begin trial at your own risk.  If you do not cancel or forget to cancel, they will continue to collect your money every 6 months nonstop.  Then they will cite their fine print policy about cancellations. Mind you I didn’t want refunds from previous two charges just the recent one when I discovered it.  Nope.  Their response was dismissive.  They canceled and told me app was available for next 6 months.
